Please state any conditions or implementation requirements you have.

transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to flag an accounting implementation requirement. As a result, this position must be recorded at fair value through profit or loss rather than held at amortized cost. My accounting memo on this is awaiting circulation, but I wanted to make sure the committee is aware of this classification requirement before the vote.

I confirmed with the execution desk today that their $5 million cap is a per-cycle maximum, and any purchase must be sized at exactly $5 million face value -- not $12 million -- executed over exactly four trading days in a single cycle. Multi-cycle phasing to exceed $5 million total is not permitted. So if we proceed, we're talking about a $5 million face value slice of this block, which at 82 cents on the dollar means a purchase cost of roughly $4.1 million. commitments.detail: Purchase sized at $5 million face value (approx. $4.1 million cost at 82 cents on the dollar), executed over exactly four trading days in a single cycle.
Position to be recorded at fair value through profit or loss due to contingent step-up feature in contractual cash flows.

Post-trade exposure to issuer will be $9 million ($4M existing + $5M new), leaving $1 million remaining under the $10 million single-issuer limit. Ongoing monitoring required.
